messages:
tess-finance: Note: Sparrow AI (acct SP-447) shows INV-2026-042 overdue $12,450. Sent 2 notices. Client not responding to billing emails. Any account owner updates? @omar-am

omar-am: Reached out yesterday, no reply. Their finance contact left last month. AM pinged exec sponsor, awaiting response. They asked to pause Dedicated instance if we escalate.

ryan-cs: Support ticket shows increased latency — client worried about service interruption. They said theyre trying to reconcile usage spikes.

anjali-collections: We should send final notice before suspension. Recommend 7-day final window, then suspend. Offer short-term hold off if they commit to wire within 48 hours and provide PoP.

legal-bot: Auto: standard TOS suspension clause applies after 30 days overdue. Manual approvals required for exceptions.

omar-am: Client DMd: finance team is back next week, can they have until 2026-03-25 to pay? Wants no service impact.

tess-finance: We can offer an extension to 2026-03-25 but require a payment plan or cleared wire by then. No fee waivers. Collections to issue final notice today.

anjali-collections: Sending final notice now. If no payment or POP by 2026-03-25, we suspend and route to external collections.

payment-bot: Alert: final dunning email sent to billing@sparrow-ai.com at 2026-03-05T16:02:00Z. Next automated check 2026-03-26.
